## Full About
Superior Home Builders is a licensed and insured general contractor based in Mount Vernon, Oregon, serving Grant County, Harney County, and Eastern Oregon for over 25 years. The company builds custom homes from site preparation through finish work, with particular depth in off-grid home construction on rural land — coordinating wells, septic systems, solar power, and access roads alongside the build itself. Beyond new construction, Superior Home Builders handles kitchen and bathroom remodels, whole-house renovations, structural framing, custom decks, window and door replacement, and commercial construction for local businesses including banks, motels, apartment buildings, schools, and government buildings. Additional services include metal roofing, pole barns and agricultural buildings, gutter installation, excavation and site work, Hardie siding, cedar fencing, interior and exterior painting, insulation and drywall, electrical/plumbing/HVAC (including mini-split AC), garages and outbuildings, and storm damage repair. Every project begins with a free on-site estimate and a written, itemized proposal, and all required permits are pulled by the company.

## Service Details

### Custom Home Building
Full custom home construction tailored to the client's vision and budget, from design and permitting through site preparation, framing, and finishing. Includes off-grid builds on raw rural land. Typical timeframe: 6–14 months depending on size and complexity.

### General Remodeling
Comprehensive remodeling for any room or area of the home, from single-room updates to whole-house renovations, handled from planning to final touches.

### Kitchen Remodeling
Kitchen renovation with custom cabinetry, countertops, and modern appliances. Typical cost range in Eastern Oregon: $12,000–$20,000 for a cosmetic refresh up to $35,000–$75,000+ for a full gut-and-rebuild. Typical timeframe: 3–6 weeks.

### Bathroom Remodeling
Custom bathroom renovation including tile work, fixtures, and plumbing upgrades. Typical cost range: $8,000–$12,000 for a basic update to $18,000–$35,000+ for a full renovation. Typical timeframe: 2–4 weeks.

### Windows and Doors
Replacement window and exterior door installation in existing homes, using energy-efficient vinyl, fiberglass, and wood products. Includes new vinyl windows and full window replacements.

### Decks & Porches
Trex composite decks, cedar decks, porches, and pergolas built for Eastern Oregon snow loads and freeze-thaw conditions. Steel railing installation. Ground-level, elevated, and multi-level configurations.

### Framing
Residential and commercial structural framing for new construction and remodeling projects throughout Eastern Oregon.

### Commercial Construction
Commercial construction and renovation for businesses throughout Eastern Oregon, including banks, motels, apartment buildings, schools, government buildings, and beauty salons. Projects of any scale, delivered on time.

### Roofing
Metal roofing installation (standing seam and exposed-fastener metal panels) and roof-overs for mobile homes. Metal roofing is ideal for Eastern Oregon's heavy snow loads, UV exposure, and extreme temperature swings. Typical residential metal roof replacement: $12,000–$35,000. Mobile home roof-overs: $4,500–$10,000.

### Pole Barns & Agricultural Buildings
Pole barns, horse barns, hay sheds, RV barns, storage barns, and barndominiums across Grant and Harney Counties. Sized for Eastern Oregon ranching and farming operations. Typical 30x40 storage barn: $25,000–$45,000. Barndominiums start around $100,000–$200,000 for the structure.

### Gutters
Residential and commercial gutter installation throughout Grant and Harney Counties. Proper gutter systems direct snowmelt and rain away from foundations — critical in Eastern Oregon's climate.

### Excavation & Site Work
Foundation dig-outs, grading, clearing, and property development across Eastern Oregon. From raw land preparation to foundation excavation for custom homes and agricultural structures.

### Siding
Hardie siding, T1-11 siding, log siding, and metal siding installation. Mobile home skirting. Engineered for Eastern Oregon's UV exposure, freeze-thaw cycles, and high desert conditions.

### Fencing
Cedar fencing in shadow box, privacy, and good neighbor styles. Cedar performs well in Eastern Oregon's climate and looks great for decades with minimal upkeep.

### Interior & Exterior Painting
Interior and exterior house painting across Grant and Harney Counties. Quality paints suited for Eastern Oregon conditions — UV-resistant exterior finishes and premium interior products.

### Insulation & Drywall
Insulation installation and drywall (sheetrock) work for new construction and remodeling. Properly specified for local elevations and climate conditions in Grant County.

### Electrical, Plumbing & HVAC
Electrical, plumbing, and HVAC services including mini-split AC system installation. All trades coordinated under one contract — no managing multiple subcontractors.

### Garages & Outbuildings
Detached garages, attached garage additions, and tack rooms throughout Eastern Oregon. RV storage garages for Class A and Class C motorhomes. Built to match your property and budget.

### Storm Damage Repair
Storm damage, water damage, and wind damage assessment and repair. Structural damage evaluation, insurance coordination, and restoration to pre-loss condition across Eastern Oregon.

## Service Area Details

### Grant County
- **Mount Vernon** (97865) — Home base. Canyon Creek corridor, Hwy 395. 2,756 ft elevation.
- **John Day** (97845) — County seat. Largest community in Grant County, 1,700+ residents. Hwy 395/26 junction.
- **Canyon City** (97820) — Historic mining community adjacent to John Day. Grant County courthouse location.
- **Prairie City** (97869) — Strawberry Mountain Wilderness gateway. 3,557 ft elevation, heavy snowloads.
- **Dayville** (97825) — John Day River corridor, Hwy 26. 2,200 ft elevation. ~150 residents.
- **Long Creek** (97856) — Northern Grant County, Hwy 395. 3,200 ft elevation. ~200 residents.
- **Monument** (97864) — North Fork John Day River. 2,800 ft elevation. ~130 residents.
- **Seneca** (97873) — Bear Valley. 4,676 ft elevation — one of the coldest spots in the contiguous US. ~200 residents. Silver Creek drainage.

### Harney County
- **Burns** (97720) — Harney County seat. 4,147 ft elevation. ~2,800 residents. Silvies River. Closest major supply hub for southeastern Oregon.
- **Hines** (97738) — Directly adjacent to Burns. 4,100 ft elevation. ~1,500 residents. Harney Basin gateway.

Note: Superior Home Builders is licensed to work throughout the state of Oregon (CCB# 147123). The above areas are primary service zones; inquiries from other Eastern Oregon communities are welcome.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is Superior Home Builders licensed and insured in Oregon?
A: Yes. Superior Home Builders is a fully licensed Oregon Construction Contractors Board contractor (CCB# 147123) and carries general liability insurance, qualified for both residential and commercial work throughout Oregon.

Q: What areas does Superior Home Builders serve?
A: Based in Mount Vernon, OR, serving Grant County communities (Mount Vernon, John Day, Canyon City, Prairie City, Dayville, Long Creek, Monument, Seneca) and Harney County communities (Burns, Hines). Licensed to work throughout the state of Oregon.

Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes — free, no-obligation estimates on all projects, starting with an on-site visit and a written, itemized estimate.

Q: What services do you offer?
A: 19 services: Custom Home Building, General Remodeling, Kitchen Remodeling, Bathroom Remodeling, Windows and Doors, Decks & Porches, Framing, Commercial Construction, Roofing, Pole Barns & Agricultural Buildings, Gutters, Excavation & Site Work, Siding, Fencing, Painting, Insulation & Drywall, Electrical/Plumbing/HVAC, Garages & Outbuildings, and Storm Damage Repair.

Q: Can you build a custom home from scratch in Eastern Oregon?
A: Yes. Custom home building is a flagship service — covering planning, permitting, site preparation, framing, and finish work, including off-grid homes on raw rural land.

Q: What type of roofing do you install?
A: We specialize in metal roofing (standing seam and exposed-fastener panels) and mobile home roof-overs. Metal roofing is the best long-term investment for Eastern Oregon given the snow loads and UV exposure.

Q: Do you build pole barns in Grant County?
A: Yes. Pole barns, horse barns, hay sheds, RV barns, storage barns, and barndominiums are a significant part of our work across Grant and Harney Counties.

Q: How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Mount Vernon, OR?
A: Typically $8,000–$12,000 for a basic update to $18,000–$35,000+ for a full renovation with tile, new fixtures, and plumbing changes.

Q: Do you do excavation and site work?
A: Yes. We handle foundation dig-outs, grading, clearing, and property development for both residential and agricultural projects across Eastern Oregon.

Q: Do you pull permits for construction work?
A: Yes. Superior Home Builders pulls all required permits for work in Grant County, Harney County, and beyond, and complies with Oregon building code throughout.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Fill out the contact form at https://superiorhomebuilderscorp.com/contact/ and describe your project — a free on-site estimate will be scheduled.
